标题: 全新NTanFine Coming Soon

是的经过我扣了一晚上递归，终于写好了查找主题的功能~
上代码：

  1. #!/usr/bin/env node
  2. const ROOT = process.env.HOME || process.env.USERPROFILE;
  3. const log = require("../libs/log");
  4. const net = require("../libs/nget");
  5. const program = require("commander");
  6. const finder = require("../libs/finder");
  7. const fs = require("fs");

  9. program.option("-v, --verbose", "output debug info");
  10. program
  11.   .command("add-repo <repo name> <repo link>")
  12.   .description("add a repo record for installer to search")
  13.   .action((name, link) => {
  14.     addRepo(name, link);
  15.   });
  16. program
  17.   .command("remove-repo <repo name>")
  18.   .description("remove an existing repo record")
  19.   .action((name) => {
  20.     rmRepo(name);
  21.   });
  22. program
  23.   .command("install <theme name>")
  24.   .description("install a theme from repos using its name");
  25. program.command("uninstall <theme name>").description("uninstall a theme");

  27. program
  28.   .command("query <theme name>")
  29.   .description("query the link of a theme and use it for online loading")
  30.   .action((name) => {
  31.     query(name);
  32.   });
  33. if (!fs.existsSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine")) {
  34.   fs.mkdirSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine");
  35.   var str = '{"content":[]}';
  36.   fs.writeFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json", str);
  37. }
  38. if (!fs.existsSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json")) {
  39.   var str = '{"content":[]}';
  40.   fs.writeFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json", str);
  41. }

  43. program.parse(process.argv);
  44. if (program.verbose) {
  45.   log.doDebug = true;
  46. }
  47. function addRepo(repo_name, repo_link) {
  48.   var repoStr = fs.readFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json").toString();
  49.   var repo = eval("(" + repoStr + ")");
  50.   for (n in repo.content) {
  51.     if (repo.content[n].name == repo_name) {
  52.       log.fatal(
  53.         "add repo",
  54.         "repo '" +
  55.           repo_name +
  56.           "' already exists, use 'ntf-get remove-repo " +
  57.           repo_name +
  58.           "' and then try to add it again."
  59.       );
  60.       process.exit(1);
  61.     }
  62.   }
  63.   var r = new Object();
  64.   r.name = repo_name;
  65.   r.href = repo_link;
  66.   repo.content[repo.content.length] = r;
  67.   log.info(
  68.     "add repo",
  69.     "added new repo '" + repo_name + "' with href as '" + repo_link + "'"
  70.   );
  71.   fs.writeFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json", JSON.stringify(repo));
  72. }

  74. function rmRepo(repo_name) {
  75.   var repoStr = fs.readFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json").toString();
  76.   var repo = eval("(" + repoStr + ")");
  77.   for (n in repo.content) {
  78.     if (repo.content[n].name == repo_name) {
  79.       repo.content.splice(n, 1);
  80.       log.info("remove repo", "removed repo '" + repo_name + "'");
  81.       fs.writeFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json", JSON.stringify(repo));
  82.       process.exit(0);
  83.     }
  84.   }
  85.   log.warn("remove repo", "no repo name '" + repo_name + "', dismissed.");
  86. }

  88. async function traceName(name, cname_link, counter) {
  89.   var ct;
  90.   var clink = cname_link;
  91.   if (cname_link.substr(-1, 1) != "/") {
  92.     clink = cname_link + "/";
  93.   }
  94.   await net.getSync(clink + "repo.json").then(function (res) {
  95.     ct = res.data;
  96.   });

  98.   var repo = eval(ct);

  100.   for (n in repo.content) {
  101.     if (repo.content[n].name == name) {
  102.       if (repo.content[n].type == "a") {
  103.         counter.count += 1;
  104.         log.info(
  105.           "query result",
  106.           "response from '" +
  107.             repo.name +
  108.             "': '" +
  109.             name +
  110.             "' -> '" +
  111.             repo.content[n].value +
  112.             "'"
  113.         );
  114.         if (!repo.content[n].official) {
  115.           log.warn(
  116.             "unofficial response",
  117.             "the response '" +
  118.               repo.content[n].value +
  119.               "' is not an official response, check it before load!"
  120.           );
  121.         } else {
  122.           counter.ocount += 1;
  123.         }
  124.       } else if (repo.content[n].type == "p") {
  125.         log.debug("redirect", "redirected to '" + repo.content[n].value + "'");
  126.         traceName(name, repo.content[n].value, counter);
  127.       }
  128.     }
  129.   }
  130. }

  132. function query(name) {
  133.   var a = {
  134.     count: 0,
  135.     ocount: 0,
  136.   };
  137.   var repoStr = fs.readFileSync(ROOT + "/.ntfine/repo.json").toString();
  138.   var repo = eval("(" + repoStr + ")");
  139.   log.info("query repo", "start querying");
  140.   for (r in repo.content) {
  141.     log.info("query repo", "querying '" + repo.content[r].name + "'");
  142.     traceName(name, repo.content[r].href, a);
  143. s}
  144.   process.on("beforeExit", function () {
  145.     log.info(
  146.       "finished",
  147.       "query finished, " +
  148.         log.CHALK.green(a.count.toString()) +
  149.         " responses and " +
  150.         log.CHALK.greenBright.bold(a.ocount.toString()) +
  151.         " official responses found."
  152.     );
  153.   });
  154. }

此外：NTanFine登陆NPM啦！
现在您可以使用npm安装ntanfine：
  1. npm install ntanfine-launcher -g
复制代码

（测试版，功能不完善）
可以使用：
- ntf-cli install 来下载加载器，下载的位置是当前目录/.ntfine/content/<版本号>，其中<版本号>文件夹就是一个Chrome插件，可以直接载入。
- ntf-get query <名称> 在所有仓库查找主题（虽然好像就只有mcbbs和equestria）
- ntf-get add-repo <名称> <URL> 添加主题仓库
- ntf-get remove-repo <名称> 移除仓库


现在仅有的两个仓库是https://ntfine.xuogroup.top/repo1 和 https://ntfine.xuogroup.top/repo-classic


祝我好运吧！

  5490.       "label": "Rainbow Cookie Zombie Effects",
  5491.       "notes": "Colors of this effect are not muted even if the pony's coat ends up muted. This effect is dimmed with any night filters.\nTo get the muted coat/mane/other colors for any character, take the RGB value of the color, average the R, G, B values, and adjust each RGB value 50% of the way to that average. For example, if RGB is 120, 60, 120, the average is 100. The R value of 120 would then move 50%*(120-100) or 10 (ending up at 110), the G value of 60 would move 50%*(100-60) or 20 (ending up at 80).",

  15244.       "label": "Rainbow Cookie Zombie Effects",
  15245.       "notes": "Colors of this effect are not muted even if the pony's coat ends up muted. This effect is dimmed with any night filters.\nTo get the muted coat/mane/other colors for any character, take the RGB value of the color, average the R, G, B values, and adjust each RGB value 50% of the way to that average. For example, if RGB is 120, 60, 120, the average is 100. The R value of 120 would then move 50%*(120-100) or 10 (ending up at 110), the G value of 60 would move 50%*(100-60) or 20 (ending up at 80).",
